test_case.purpose: Verify both front USB2 ports sustain their approved workload for 12 hours at measured low-rail margin without per-port or shared-controller failures.
test_case.test_command: Operator maps both ports/tools/hub, preserves baseline, ramps to measured 40C/-5% rails, verifies both USB2 paths, runs the complete simultaneous or separately attributable 12-hour SST profile with per-port and controller evidence, then restores nominal rails/ambient and health.

test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires both port identities, complete per-port duration, common low-rail trace and restoration. One port, +5%/nominal evidence, aggregate logs or a short run cannot pass.

Preserve evidence; restore nominal; no retry
test_case.recovery: Stop on either-port or environmental fault, preserve common/per-port evidence, ramp safely to nominal, verify both ports/system and do not automatically rerun.
